Title: General availability: Event Hubs Capture (formerly Archive)

Body.Content:
Azure Event Hubs Capture, released in public preview in September 2016 as Azure Event Hubs Archive, is now generally available. Event Hubs Capture makes it easy to send data to persistent storage without using code or configuring other compute services.

For more information, see the blog post.
